new_learnings.text: Rule 5 -3% in 3 days trigger worked perfectly: 鹏辉能源 caught a false breakout (¥92→¥75 intraday, 18% swing on 碳酸锂 crash). Cutting at -3.24% prevents this from becoming a -8% disaster.

new_learnings.text: Index divergence (上证+0.44% vs 科创50 -2.48%) with 3.78:1 breadth is a textbook rotation signal: profit-taking in extended tech leaders, rotation into lagging cyclicals. This is not a broad selloff.
new_learnings.mechanism: When breadth is strong but large-cap tech indices sell off, capital is rotating within the market. The 'troops' are being bought while 'generals' are sold.
